description: Defines a RecyclerView adapter (ContentCardAdapter) for displaying focusable content cards on an Android TV app, with image loading via Glide and handling focus/selection visuals.

classes.name: ContentCardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for content cards, supporting focus and click handling with animated visual feedback.

classes.name: CardVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual content card views, images, and focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolder and sets key event listener for focus/selection.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Populates the ViewHolder views with ContentItem data, loads images, and sets accessibility content description.
